set_text.text: The 35% stands in for every line that is not a staple. If those lines carry different markups, type one combined markup: their total profit divided by their total cost.
Contract sales at their own rate
Cases sold to chains on cost plus a fee do not carry your list markup. Leave them in at 35% and the blend reads wrong, usually high.
Where VOS fits in your sales mix
Reps free to sell, not take orders
VOS does not calculate markups or measure your blend. It moves routine order taking off your reps: customers order by voice in the VOS app, and orders arrive confirmed.
20-30 minutes saved per order compared with a phone order
Each account orders from its own guide, at your prices
Order history per account in one admin platform
Works alongside your ERP, with nothing to rip out
